22215.context: Because if your identity is still completely organized around the thing that you left, then the thing that you left is still organizing you. And the next step, the harder step, is if no one ever told me who to be, who would I be? Who would I choose now? And that's where a much more authentic sense of of identity will start to take root after a religious deconstruction. So hope that made sense. Hope that gave you some grace if you look back on that phase with with any level of cringe. Uh, but all of this is just healthy human development where hopefully you end up with a very stable sense of identity that then you can take off at any time because you're not you're not your identity.
